Sam: quick notewe're seeing rare duplicate streaming charges when mobile toggles from WS -> SSE during NAT churn. two endpoints both billed the same replay window.
Priya: drop a tiny trace? need to know if session id was reused or a new session minted.
Sam: sanitized trace:
2026-03-23T08:12:01Z INFO conn accepted proto=ws session=zz9 route=us-central-1-a resume_tok=tok:old
2026-03-23T08:12:04Z WARN client-ip-change old=10.0.0.1 new=100.64.1.9 landed route=us-central-1-b
2026-03-23T08:12:05Z INFO resume accepted proto=sse session=zz9 route=us-central-1-b resume_tok=tok:old
2026-03-23T08:12:10Z BILL charge route=us-central-1-a session=zz9 tokens=75
2026-03-23T08:12:11Z BILL charge route=us-central-1-b session=zz9 tokens=28
Carlos: same session reused, token valid across routes. root cause = overlap window where both workers think they own session.
Lila: options: (1) shrink tombstone 30s->2s (risky), (2) pubsub handoff event on resume accept so old-route revokes billing, (3) control-plane serialisation (adds latency).
Priya: (2) seems best: best-effort pubsub + idempotent revoke. canary it. Also token-v2 to include issued_route + nonce so new-route can detect cross-route resumes.
Carlos: PoC for (2) reduced duplicates by ~95% in 8% canary. new-route publishes "session.handoff" {session, new_route, nonce}, old-route sees and stops billing.
Lila: telemetry: emit resume_schema (legacy/v2), session_handoff_latency histogram, resume_route_mismatch counter, per-tenant duplicate_stream_charge gauge. Console: session timeline showing accept, handoff, revoke, billing ticks + "request-billing-review" button.
infra-bot: canary deploy for session.handoff -> 8% us-central started 2026-03-23T11:00:00Z. monitor duplicate_stream_charge and handoff_latency_p95.
billing-bot: sampled alert at 2026-03-23T11:07:05Z: duplicate_stream_charge > baseline for us-central; sample_count=7 top_tenant=beta-co.
Sam: plan: continue canary 24h, collect histogram (Carlos), write RFC for token-v2 (Priya), Console UI + support button (Lila). add short-term billing guard: billing path checks a small LRU of recent handoffs (TTL=60s) to skip billed tokens if session handed_off.
Priya: RFC sketch: token-v2 fields = session_id, issued_route, epoch, handoff_nonce, flags.force_claim. If issued_route != current and !force_claim -> return 409 claim-required with claim_nonce. client retries and server publishes claim.
Carlos: agree on backward compat: accept legacy tokens but tag telemetry, rotate tokens on session restart.
Lila: UX rollout: session timeline behind beta flag for ops for 1 week -> then wider. set alert page only if single-tenant duplicate > $50 over 10m.
Sam: thanks all. I'll attach repro harness (WS->SSE NAT flip) to ticket and link traces. cc @support for prefilled billing review payload. :wave:
